data.name: RegisterHeading
data.comment: The registration page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: RegisterIntro
data.value: You get a Space of your own straight away. There is nothing else to decide.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States what registering gets you, because the whole point of this flow is that no structural decision is asked for. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: DisplayNameLabel
data.comment: Label for the display-name field. Deliberately not "full name" or "real name" - it is whatever this person wants to be called, and it is what their Space is named after.

data.name: DisplayNameHint
data.value: Your Space will be named after this.
data.comment: Help text under the name field, explaining a consequence that is otherwise a surprise.

data.name: EmailAddressLabel
data.comment: Label for the email field.

data.name: PasswordLabel
data.comment: Label for the password field.

data.name: SubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SubmitInFlight
data.value: Creating your Account. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - the password hashing is meant to be slow - so the copy says so plainly rather than leaving a person wondering whether anything happened. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SubmitComplete
data.value: Your Account is ready, and so is your Space.
data.comment: Announced when registration completes. Deliberately plain - no celebration. Note this is shown whether the address was new or already registered; the two are indistinguishable by design, so this copy must never imply that something was created just now for the first time.

data.name: SubmitFailed
data.value: That could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
data.comment: Shown when the request never reached the server, or the server answered with something unexpected. It is about the transport, not about the submission.

data.name: ErrorHeading
data.value: Check the form and try again.
data.comment: Heading of the error region, announced assertively when validation fails. Followed by one line per problem.

data.name: SignInHeading
data.comment: The sign-in page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInIntro
data.value: One sign-in covers every Space you belong to.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States the promise the story is about - moving between contexts never asks who you are again. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInSubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button on the sign-in form.

data.name: SignInInFlight
data.value: Signing you in. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - checking the password is meant to be slow, and it takes the same time whether or not the address is known - so the copy says so plainly. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SignInComplete
data.comment: Announced when sign-in completes. Deliberately plain, and it names no Space: no Space is established by signing in, and there is nowhere to go yet.

data.name: SignInFailed
data.comment: THE ONLY MESSAGE FOR A FAILED SIGN-IN, AND IT COVERS EVERY CAUSE. Printed verbatim in the experience spine. It must never become "no account found", "wrong password" or anything else that says which of the two happened - the server answers one problem type with no detail, so this string is the whole of what a person is told, by design. Do not add a second string beside it, and do not add a "create an Account instead?" nudge here.

data.name: SignInToRegisterLink
data.comment: Link to the registration surface, below the sign-in form. It exists because "/" is now sign-in and registration would otherwise be reachable only by typing a path. It is NOT a response to a failed sign-in and must never be shown as one - that would say the address is unknown. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SessionEnded
data.value: Your Session ended. Sign in to continue.
data.comment: Shown when a person is returned here because their Session expired or stopped being valid. It names the Session and NOTHING else - no Space name, no Membership information, and never "you were removed": this is the cold path, where the person is not in a Space and must not be told anything about one. "Session" is Glossary vocabulary and is capitalised in every language, per rule 2 at the top of this file.

data.name: NotFoundHeading
data.comment: Heading of the page shown for an address that matches no route. No full stop: it is a heading, not a sentence.

data.name: NotFoundBody
data.value: Check the address, or go back to where you were.
data.comment: Body of the not-found page. Deliberately offers no link: there is only one page in the product so far, and a link to it would read as a suggestion rather than a route.

data.name: display-name-required
data.value: Enter the name you want to be called by.

data.name: email-address-too-long
data.value: That email address is too long.

data.name: email-address-malformed
data.value: That does not look like an email address.
data.comment: Deliberately hedged - "does not look like" rather than "is invalid" - because the check is intentionally shallow and should not tell someone their real address is wrong.
